name: Frostsaber Replacement
summary: Frostsaber Replacement is a quiet exchange overseen by Lelanai in the leafy enclave of Darnassus. It allows riders who once commanded the older breeds of night elf mounts, such as the Ancient Frostsaber, to trade in their reins for newer breeds raised in the boughs of Teldrassil. While a simple administrative arrangement, it reflects the ongoing shifts in how the night elves equip and supply Alliance travelers.

sections.title: A Change of Mounts
sections.body: In the Enclave of the Night Elves within Darnassus, trainers and breeders oversee the fierce great cats that serve as mounts for the kaldorei. Over recent years, older lineages of frostsaber mounts—such as the ancient, unarmored breeds—have grown increasingly scarce, replaced by newly trained lines bred for endurance and war across Kalimdor. Handlers like Lelanai facilitate exchanges for riders holding older reins wishing to update their stable companion.

sections.title: The Breeders of Darnassus
sections.body: Lelanai tends to the night elves' mounts near the Cenarion Enclave, providing the iconic frostsaber cats to trusted champions of the Alliance. When older tack and lineages are returned to her, they are retired gracefully or re-fitted to match the standard harnesses utilized by the Sentinels and allied forces.

faq.answer: It is an exchange offered by Lelanai in Darnassus, allowing an adventurer possessing an older breed of frostsaber, specifically the Ancient Frostsaber, to trade their reins for an updated mount.

Lelanai is the night elf sabercat handler stationed at the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. She sells night elf racial mounts and handles trades for adventurers seeking to acquire or change their frostsaber mounts.

faq.q: Where does this trade take place?
faq.answer: This exchange occurs in Darnassus, located high within the crown of the great tree Teldrassil, near the trainer platforms of the Cenarion Enclave.

faq.q: Why were older frostsaber mounts replaced?
faq.answer: As kaldorei breeders standardized gear and war harnesses for the Alliance, older variants—like the swift, unarmored ancient frostsaber breeds—were phased out in favor of newer stock, prompting handlers like Lelanai to exchange older bridles for active riders.

faq.q: Can members of other Alliance races do this exchange?
faq.answer: Any Alliance champion who earned the trust of Darnassus and secured an older Ancient Frostsaber mount can present their reins to Lelanai for the exchange.

faq.q: Do you lose your original cat when you complete this?
faq.answer: Yes. Surrendering the reins of the Ancient Frostsaber to Lelanai permanently exchanges it for a modern breed, meaning the older lineage cannot be reclaimed once turned in.

angles.text: The great cats of Teldrassil and Winterspring are revered kin and steadfast companions to the kaldorei, nurtured under the watchful guidance of caretakers like Lelanai.
Allied champions of the Alliance who demonstrate sufficient standing with Darnassus are welcomed to bond with and ride these sacred frostsaber breeds.
